1. Omfang og eskalering1. Scope and escalation

1.1 Formål og ansvarsfordeling1.1 Purpose and responsibilities

Denne guide definerer omfang og procedurer for CPH Operations-teamets førstelinjeindsats ved fejl på LED-skærmsystemet i Terminal 3 Check-in 21–38. CPH Operations-teamet er ansvarligt for:

This guide defines the scope and procedures for the CPH Operations team's first-line response to faults on the LED screen system in Terminal 3 Check-in 21–38. The CPH Operations team is responsible for:

  • At holde skærmen i drift og levere korrekt indhold
  • Keeping the screen operational and delivering correct content
  • Verificering af strøm og signal fysisk gennem signalkæden
  • Physically verifying power and signal integrity through the signal chain
  • Aflæsning og fortolkning af LED-indikatorer på kabinetternes motherboard og Expromo EPS-bokse
  • Reading and interpreting LED indicators on cabinet motherboards and Expromo EPS boxes
  • Fysisk udskiftning af defekte komponenter: LED-modul, Motherboard (HUB), Modtagekortet (RxCard) og H15 input-/outputkort
  • Physically replacing faulty components: LED module, Motherboard (HUB), Receiving Card (RxCard) and H15 input/output cards
HVAD CPH OPERATIONS IKKE GØR — RING L2 VED DISSE: WHAT CPH OPERATIONS DOES NOT DO — CALL L2 FOR THESE:
  • Åbne WebUI, NovaLCT eller anden konfigurationssoftware
  • Open WebUI, NovaLCT or any configuration software
  • Overføre konfigurationsfiler (.ncp), rcfgx-filer eller firmware
  • Transfer configuration files (.ncp), rcfgx files or firmware
  • Kalibrere farve eller lysstyrke
  • Calibrate colour or brightness
  • Ændre netværkskonfiguration
  • Change network configuration

WebUI, NovaLCT og Control Protocol/API er L2-værktøjer. Der er en separat L2-guide til disse.

WebUI, NovaLCT and Control Protocol/API are L2 tools. A separate L2 guide covers these.

2. Signalkæden2. The signal chain

Skærmsystemet er segmenteret. En fejl påvirker kun sit eget segment — ikke alt nedenfor. Specielt:

The screen system is segmented. A fault affects only its own segment — not everything downstream. Specifically:

  • En FIDS-controller fejler → ca. 4–6 kabinetter (ét check-in-bord) viser sort billede eller fryser på det sidst modtagne billede
  • A FIDS player fails → approx. 4–6 cabinets (one check-in desk section) show black or freeze on the last received frame
  • En CVT10-S fejler → ca. 8 søjler (16 kabinetter) fryser på det sidst modtagne billede — RxCard-indikatoren på berørte kabinetter begynder at blinke (signal tabt)
  • A CVT10-S fails → approx. 8 columns (16 cabinets) freeze on the last received frame — the RxCard indicator on affected cabinets begins to flash (signal lost)
  • En EPS-boks mister strøm → ca. 16 søjler (32 kabinetter) slukker — inkl. den tilknyttede NovaStar fiberkonverter (CVT10-S)
  • An EPS box loses power → approx. 16 columns (32 cabinets) power off — including the associated NovaStar Fiber Converter (CVT10-S)
STRØMDIAGNOSTIK — BRUG EPS-MANUALEN: POWER DIAGNOSTICS — USE THE EPS MANUAL:

Strømfejl diagnosticeres via EPS-boksens egne indikatorer (RGB-LED og WebUI). Brug Expromo EPS CPH Airport Special Dokumentation v2.0.0 parallelt med denne guide til strømrelaterede fejl. Afsnit 4.2 i denne guide opsummerer EPS RGB-indikatorerne.

Power faults are diagnosed via the EPS box's own indicators (RGB LED and web interface). Use the Expromo EPS CPH Airport Special Documentation v2.0.0 alongside this guide for power-related faults. Section 4.2 of this guide summarises the EPS RGB indicators.

Figur: Komplet signalkæde og strømforsyning — Terminal 3 Check-in 21–38. Søjle = 2 stablede kabinetter (bund + top). Signal og strøm løber ind i bundkabinettet. EPS SSR2 strømstyrer også CVT10-S-fiberkonverteren.

Figure: Complete signal chain and power supply — Terminal 3 Check-in 21–38. Column = 2 stacked cabinets (bottom + top). Signal and power enter at the bottom cabinet. EPS SSR2 also powers the CVT10-S fibre converter.

3. Fejllokalisering efter symptom3. Fault isolation by symptom

NØGLEDIAGNOSTIK: Jo MERE der er sort, jo HØJERE OPP i kæden er fejlen. KEY DIAGNOSTIC: The MORE that is black, the HIGHER UP the chain the fault is.
  • Hele skærmen sort/frossen → alle FIDS-controllere nede ELLER H15-controller-fejl
  • Whole screen black/frozen → all FIDS players down OR H15 controller fault
  • Ca. 8 søjler er sorte eller frosne → én CVT10-S (dens fiber, SFP+ eller strøm)
  • Approx. 8 columns are black or frozen → one CVT10-S (its fibre, SFP+ or power)
  • Ca. 16 søjler sorte → EPS-boks SSR'er slukket eller defekt EPS
  • Approx. 16 columns black → EPS box SSRs off or faulty EPS
  • 1 søjle sort (bund + top) → bundkabinet (RxCard/Motherboard/PSU/Cat6A ind)
  • 1 column black (bottom + top) → bottom cabinet (RxCard/Motherboard/PSU/Cat6A in)
  • Kun top sort → Cat6A link bund→top, eller topkabinettets RxCard/Motherboard/PSU
  • Top only black → Cat6A link bottom→top, or top cabinet's RxCard/Motherboard/PSU

3.1 Hele skærmen sort eller frossen3.1 Whole screen is black or frozen

Næsten alle søjler er sorte eller frosne. Den statistisk langt mest sandsynlige årsag er enten at alle FIDS-controllere er nede, eller at H15-controlleren er fejlet. Chancen for at alle 8 CVT10-S, alle SFP+ porte og alle sendekort fejler samtidigt er ekstremt lav.

Nearly all columns are black or frozen. Statistically the most likely cause is either that all FIDS players are down, or that the H15 controller has failed. The probability that all 8 CVT10-S, all SFP+ ports and all sending cards fail simultaneously is extremely low.

3.2 Ca. 8 søjler sorte eller frosne — én CVT10-S3.2 Approx. 8 columns black or frozen — one CVT10-S

En klart afgrænset blok på ca. 8 søjler er sort eller frossen på det sidst modtagne billede. Nabokolonner virker normalt. Berørte kabinetters RxCard-indikator vil blinke (signal tabt).

A clearly bounded block of approx. 8 columns is black or frozen on the last received frame. Adjacent columns work normally. Affected cabinets' RxCard indicator will flash (signal lost).

INSTALLATION: INSTALLATION: Der er 8 CVT10-S i alt: 7 fuldt besatte (8 søjler / 16 kabinetter hver) og 1 delvist besat med 5 søjler / 10 kabinetter. Identifikation: kontrollér hvilken CVT10-S der dækker det sorte segment via kabeloversigten. There are 8 CVT10-S units in total: 7 fully loaded (8 columns / 16 cabinets each) and 1 partially loaded with 5 columns / 10 cabinets. Identification: check which CVT10-S covers the black segment via the cable overview.

3.3 Ca. 16 søjler sorte — EPS-fejl eller EPS afbrudt3.3 Approx. 16 columns black — EPS fault or EPS off

Ca. 16 sammenhængende søjler (32 kabinetter) er sorte. Inkluderer muligvis tilhørende CVT10-S. Én EPS-boks styrer ca. 16 søjler / 32 kabinetter (SSR1: 16 kab. + SSR2: 16 kab. inkl. CVT10-S). Se Expromo EPS CPH Airport Special Dokumentation v2.0.0 for detaljeret EPS-diagnostik.

Approx. 16 contiguous columns (32 cabinets) are black. May include associated CVT10-S. One EPS box controls approx. 16 columns / 32 cabinets (SSR1: 16 cab. + SSR2: 16 cab. incl. CVT10-S). See Expromo EPS CPH Airport Special Documentation v2.0.0 for detailed EPS diagnostics.

Orange fault pattern → see §4.1. OK but black → replace RxCard (§5c) or CALL L2

3.6 Ét enkelt modul — forkert farve eller korn3.6 Single module — wrong colour or grainy

Et enkelt modul viser forkert farve, er kornete eller har et unormalt mønster, mens resten af kabinettet ser normal ud.

A single module displays wrong colour, appears grainy or shows an abnormal pattern, while the rest of the cabinet looks normal.

NÆSTEN ALTID: NYUDSKIFTET MODUL MANGLER KALIBRERINGSDATA ALMOST ALWAYS: RECENTLY REPLACED MODULE MISSING CALIBRATION DATA

Forkert farve eller korn på ét modul er næsten altid tegn på at modulet er nyudskiftet og endnu ikke har fået kalibrerings-readback og farvekorrigering overført fra L2. Eskalér til L2 — forsøg ikke at rette dette fysisk.

Wrong colour or grain on a single module almost always indicates a recently replaced module that has not yet had calibration read-back and colour correction transferred by L2. Escalate to L2 — do not attempt to fix this physically.

4. Indikator-LED — dine fejlkoder4. Indicator LEDs — your error codes

LED-indikatorerne på RxCard og Expromo EPS-boksene er det primære diagnostikværktøj for CPH Operations-teamet. Ingen software-adgang er nødvendig for at aflæse disse.

The LED indicators on the RxCard and Expromo EPS boxes are the primary diagnostic tool for the CPH Operations team. No software access is required to read these.

4.1 RxCard LED-indikatorer (i hvert LED-kabinet)4.1 RxCard LED indicators (in every LED cabinet)

Modtagekortet (RxCard) er monteret på bagsiden af Motherboard (HUB). Kortets to LED-indikatorer er placeret bag ved det øverste venstre modul i kabinettet. For at se dem: fjern modul nr. 1 (øverste venstre).

The Receiving Card (RxCard) is mounted on the rear of the Motherboard (HUB). Its two LED indicators are located behind the top-left module in the cabinet. To see them: remove module no. 1 (top-left).

5. Udskiftningsprocedurer5. Replacement procedures

SIKKERHEDS-GRUNDREGLER — GÆLDER FOR ALLE PROCEDURER: SAFETY GROUND RULES — APPLIES TO ALL PROCEDURES:
  • Strøm: Sluk altid strøm til det pågældende kabinet (via EPS SSR eller lokal PSU-afbryder) inden udskiftning af Motherboard (HUB) og RxCard. Moduler er hot-swap.
  • Power: Always power off the relevant cabinet (via EPS SSR or local PSU switch) before replacing the Motherboard (HUB) and RxCard. Modules are hot-swap.
  • Håndtering: Hold elektroniske komponenter i kanterne. Rør aldrig printets guldkontaktflader.
  • Handling: Hold electronic components by the edges. Never touch the board's gold contact surfaces.
  • Stop: Hvis noget modstår dit tryk eller ikke ser rigtigt ud — stop og ring L2.
  • Stop: If anything resists your push or doesn't look right — stop and call L2.
  • Moduler blandes ikke kabinetter imellem — hvert kabinet har sit eget kalibreringssæt.
  • Do not mix modules between cabinets — each cabinet has its own calibration set.
L1 AFSLUTTER ALTID MED: L1 ALWAYS ENDS WITH:

L1's opgave afsluttes når den nye komponent er fysisk monteret og LED-indikatoren er normal. Ring herefter L2 — de verificerer konfigurationsfil (.ncp), kalibrering og firmware-match. Billedet vil ikke se korrekt ud uden dette L2-trin.

L1's task ends when the new component is physically installed and the LED indicator is normal. Then call L2 — they verify configuration file (.ncp), calibration and firmware match. The image will not look correct without this L2 step.

5a. Udskiftning af LED-modul (hot-swap)5a. LED module replacement (hot-swap)

Hvornår: Et modul er sort, mørkt eller viser forkert farve/korn og er bekræftet defekt (ikke blot ukalibreret — se §3.6). Modulet sættes direkte i sin port på Motherboard (HUB) — ingen kabler tilsluttes separat.

When: A module is black, dark or shows wrong colour/grain and is confirmed faulty (not merely uncalibrated — see §3.6). The module seats directly into its port on the Motherboard (HUB) — no cables are connected separately.

HOT-SWAP: Kabinettet BEHØVER IKKE SLUKKES for at udskifte et modul. HOT-SWAP: The cabinet does NOT need to be powered off to replace a module.

Modul-layout i kabinettetModule layout in cabinet

Hvert kabinet har 8 moduler arrangeret i 2 rækker × 4 kolonner. Kabinettets nummerindikator er synlig på forsiden. Behold kabinettets moduler i rækkefølge — bland aldrig moduler fra forskellige kabinetter.

Each cabinet has 8 modules arranged in 2 rows × 4 columns. The cabinet number indicator is visible on the front. Keep each cabinet's modules in order — never mix modules from different cabinets.

1
2
3
4
5
6
7
8

Modul 1 = øverste venstre (RxCard LED bag dette modul). Modul 8 = nederste højre.

Module 1 = top-left (RxCard LED is behind this module). Module 8 = bottom-right.

☐ # TrinStep
☐ 1 Identificér modulets position (nummer 1–8). Notér positionen.Identify the module's position (number 1–8). Note the position.
☐ 2 Anvend sugekop-værktøjet: placér sugekop på modulets flade, tryk og løft modulet vandret ud af sin port i Motherboard (HUB). Modulet glider ud.Use the suction-cup tool: place suction cup on the module's flat surface, press and lift the module straight out of its port on the Motherboard (HUB). The module slides out.
☐ 3 Kontrollér Motherboard (HUB)-porten: er stifterne intakte og porten ren og fri for fremmedlegemer?Inspect the Motherboard (HUB) port: are the pins intact and the port clean and free of foreign material?
☐ 4 Hold det nye modul i samme position (ret op med kabinettet). Sæt modulet direkte ned i porten med jævnt tryk indtil det sidder fast.Hold the new module in the correct orientation (aligned with the cabinet). Seat the module directly into the port with even pressure until it is fully secured.
☐ 5 Fastgør modulets skruer/klips.Tighten the module's screws/clips.
☐ 6 Verifikation: Lyser modulet? Kontrollér orange RxCard LED-indikator (tag modul 1 ud midlertidigt) — normal blink 1/sek?Verification: Does the module light up? Check orange RxCard LED indicator (temporarily remove module 1) — normal 1 flash/sec?
STOP — RING L2 STOP — CALL L2

Modulet er monteret og LED er normal — ring L2 for kalibrerings-readback og farvekorrigering.

The module is installed and the LED is normal — call L2 for calibration read-back and colour correction.

5b. Udskiftning af Motherboard (HUB)5b. Motherboard (HUB) replacement

Hvornår: Diagnostik peger på Motherboard (HUB) som defekt. Svarer til kundens "udskiftning af bundkort." Motherboard er ikke hot-swap — strøm skal afbrydes til kabinettet.

When: Diagnostics point to the Motherboard (HUB) as faulty. Corresponds to the customer request: "replacement of motherboard (bundkort)." The Motherboard is not hot-swap — power must be disconnected from the cabinet.

☐ # TrinStep
☐ 1 Strøm AFBRYD: Afbryd strøm til kabinettet via EPS SSR-kommandoen (CPH) eller lokal PSU-afbryder. Kontrollér at rød RxCard LED er slukket.POWER OFF: Disconnect power to the cabinet via EPS SSR command (CPH) or local PSU switch. Verify red RxCard LED is off.
☐ 2 Fjern alle 8 moduler med sugekop-værktøjet i rækkefølge (1–8). Læg dem i nummereret rækkefølge.Remove all 8 modules using the suction-cup tool in order (1–8). Lay them out in numbered order.
☐ 3 Fotografér kabelplaceringen på Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet/Cat6A, strømkabler, alle stik.Photograph cable positions on the Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet/Cat6A, power cables, all connectors.
☐ 4 Frakobl alle kabler fra Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet-kabel (Cat6A ind fra CVT10-S), Cat6A-link til/fra nabokabinettet, strømkabel fra PSU.Disconnect all cables from the Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet cable (Cat6A in from CVT10-S), Cat6A link to/from adjacent cabinet, power cable from PSU.
☐ 5 Løsn monteringsskruer på Motherboard og tag pladen ud af kabinettet. Hold den i kanterne.Loosen mounting screws on Motherboard (HUB) and take the board out of the cabinet. Hold it by the edges.
☐ 6 Placér den nye Motherboard (HUB) i kabinettet. Stram skruerne.Place the new Motherboard (HUB) in the cabinet. Tighten the screws.
☐ 7 Gentilslut alle kabler til den nye Motherboard (HUB) i original position (brug foto fra trin 3): Cat6A fra CVT10-S, Cat6A link, strøm fra PSU.Reconnect all cables to the new Motherboard (HUB) in original positions (use photo from step 3): Cat6A from CVT10-S, Cat6A link, power from PSU.
☐ 8 Genplacér alle 8 moduler i kabinettet i original nummereret rækkefølge: sæt hvert modul direkte ned i sin port med jævnt tryk.Replace all 8 modules in the cabinet in original numbered order: seat each module directly into its port with even pressure.
☐ 9 Strøm TIL: Tænd strøm til kabinettet via EPS SSR-kommandoen (CPH). Vent 30 sekunder.POWER ON: Switch power on to cabinet via EPS SSR command (CPH). Wait 30 seconds.

STOP — RING L2 STOP — CALL L2

Motherboard (HUB) er monteret og LED er normal — ring L2 for RxCard .ncp-konfigurationsfil, kalibrering og firmware-verificering.

The Motherboard (HUB) is installed and the LED is normal — call L2 for RxCard .ncp configuration file, calibration and firmware verification.

5c. Udskiftning af modtagekortet (RxCard)5c. Receiving card (RxCard) replacement

Hvornår: RxCard LED-indikator viser vedvarende fejl (orange LED slukket eller fejlmønster), og kabelcheck ikke retter fejlen. Svarer til kundens "udskiftning af modtagekortet." RxCard sidder monteret på bagsiden af Motherboard (HUB). Proceduren er den samme som 5B (udskiftning af Motherboard): Motherboard afmonteres helt, RxCard udskiftes på bagsiden, og Motherboard genmonteres. Motherboard er ikke hot-swap — strøm skal afbrydes til kabinettet.

When: RxCard LED indicator shows persistent fault (orange LED off or fault pattern), and cable check does not clear the fault. Corresponds to the customer request: "replacement of receiving card." The RxCard is mounted on the rear of the Motherboard (HUB). The procedure is the same as 5B (Motherboard replacement): the Motherboard is fully removed, the RxCard is swapped on its rear, and the Motherboard is refitted. The Motherboard is not hot-swap — power must be disconnected from the cabinet.

☐ 2 Fjern alle 8 moduler med sugekop-værktøjet i rækkefølge (1–8). Læg dem i nummereret rækkefølge.Remove all 8 modules using the suction-cup tool in order (1–8). Lay them out in numbered order.
☐ 3 Fotografér kabelplaceringen på Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet/Cat6A, strømkabler, alle stik.Photograph cable positions on the Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet/Cat6A, power cables, all connectors.
☐ 4 Frakobl alle kabler fra Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet-kabel (Cat6A ind fra CVT10-S), Cat6A-link til/fra nabokabinettet, strømkabel fra PSU.Disconnect all cables from the Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet cable (Cat6A in from CVT10-S), Cat6A link to/from adjacent cabinet, power cable from PSU.
☐ 5 Løsn monteringsskruer på Motherboard og tag pladen ud af kabinettet. Hold den i kanterne, og læg den på en ren, plan arbejdsflade med bagsiden opad.Loosen mounting screws on the Motherboard (HUB) and take the board out of the cabinet. Hold it by the edges and place it on a clean, flat work surface with the rear facing up.
☐ 6 Fotografér RxCardets kabelplacering på bagsiden af Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet-indgangskabel, strømkabel og alle signalstik.Photograph the RxCard cable positions on the rear of the Motherboard (HUB): Ethernet input cable, power cable and all signal connectors.
☐ 7 Frakobl alle kabler fra RxCard: Ethernet-indgangskabel, strømkabel og alle signalstik.Disconnect all cables from the RxCard: Ethernet input cable, power cable and all signal connectors.
☐ 8 Løsn RxCardets monteringsskruer og tag det gamle RxCard ud. Hold det i kanterne.Loosen the RxCard mounting screws and remove the old RxCard. Hold it by its edges.
☐ 9 Placér det nye RxCard i monteringsslotten på bagsiden af Motherboard og stram skruerne.Place the new RxCard in the mounting slot on the rear of the Motherboard and tighten the screws.
☐ 10 Gentilslut alle RxCard-kabler i original position (brug foto fra trin 6).Reconnect all RxCard cables in original positions (use photo from step 6).

☐ 12 Gentilslut alle kabler til Motherboard (HUB) i original position (brug foto fra trin 3): Cat6A fra CVT10-S, Cat6A link, strøm fra PSU.Reconnect all cables to the Motherboard (HUB) in original positions (use photo from step 3): Cat6A from CVT10-S, Cat6A link, power from PSU.
☐ 13 Genplacér alle 8 moduler i kabinettet i original nummereret rækkefølge: sæt hvert modul direkte ned i sin port med jævnt tryk.Replace all 8 modules in the cabinet in original numbered order: seat each module directly into its port with even pressure.
☐ 14 Strøm TIL: Tænd strøm til kabinettet via EPS SSR-kommandoen (CPH). Vent 30 sekunder.POWER ON: Switch power on to cabinet via EPS SSR command (CPH). Wait 30 seconds.

RxCard er monteret og LED er normal — ring L2. L2 skal overføre .ncp-konfigurationsfilen og verificere firmware-version. Kabinettet vil ikke vise korrekt billede uden dette trin.

RxCard is installed and LED is normal — call L2. L2 must transfer the .ncp configuration file and verify firmware version. The cabinet will not display a correct image without this step.

5d. Udskiftning af H15 input- eller outputkort (hot-swap)5d. H15 input or output card replacement (hot-swap)

Hvornår: H15 LCD viser fejl på et input- eller outputkort, og genplacering ikke hjælper. Svarer til kundens "udskiftning af input/output-kort." Disse kort understøtter hot-swap.

When: H15 LCD shows a fault on an input or output card, and reseating does not help. Corresponds to the customer request: "replacement of input/output card." These cards support hot-swap.

HOT-SWAP: H15-controlleren BEHØVER IKKE SLUKKES for at udskifte input- eller outputkort. HOT-SWAP: The H15 controller does NOT need to be powered off to replace input or output cards.
☐ # TrinStep
☐ 1 Notér det defekte korts slot-nummer og korttype (Input eller Output) fra H15 LCD.Note the faulty card's slot number and card type (Input or Output) from the H15 LCD.

☐ 3 Frakobl alle kabler fra det defekte kort. Hold stikket i stik-huset — ikke i kablet.Disconnect all cables from the faulty card. Hold the connector body — not the cable.
☐ 4 Løsn kortets fastgørelsesskruer (2 stk. på kortets beslag) og træk kortet jævnt ud af slotten.Loosen the card's retention screws (2 on card bracket) and slide the card evenly out of the slot.
☐ 5 Skub det nye kort ind i samme slot. Det skal glide jævnt — tving det aldrig. Stram fastgørelsesskruer.Slide the new card into the same slot. It should glide in smoothly — never force it. Tighten retention screws.

STOP — RING L2 STOP — CALL L2

Kort er monteret og H15 LCD viser normal status — ring L2. L2 verificerer firmware-match og konfiguration.

Card is installed and H15 LCD shows normal status — call L2. L2 verifies firmware match and configuration.

6. Tillæg6. Appendix

6.1 Ordliste6.1 Glossary

BegrebTerm ForklaringExplanation
RxCard / Modtagekortet Elektronikkort monteret på bagsiden af Motherboard (HUB). Modtager billedsignal fra CVT10-S via Cat6A og driver LED-modulerne via Motherboard (HUB)-portene. LED-indikator bag modul 1.Electronics card mounted on rear of Motherboard (HUB). Receives image signal from CVT10-S via Cat6A and drives LED modules via Motherboard (HUB) ports. LED indicator is behind module 1.
Motherboard (HUB) Den store printplade inde i kabinettet. RxCard er monteret på dens bagside. LED-modulerne sættes direkte ind i dens porte — signal og strøm overføres via porten (ingen kabler). Kræver strøm-afbrydelse ved udskiftning.The large circuit board inside the cabinet. The RxCard is mounted on its rear. LED modules seat directly into its ports — signal and power are transferred via the port (no cables). Requires power off for replacement.
LED-modul Fysisk LED-panel. 8 stk. pr. kabinet, arrangeret 1–4 øverst og 5–8 nederst. Sættes direkte i Motherboard (HUB)-port — hot-swap. Fjernes med sugekop-værktøj. Blandes aldrig kabinetter imellem.Physical LED panel. 8 per cabinet, arranged 1–4 on top and 5–8 on bottom. Seats directly into Motherboard (HUB) port — hot-swap. Removed with suction-cup tool. Never mixed between cabinets.
PSU Strømforsyningsenhed i kabinettet. Konverterer 230V (fra EPS SSR) til LED-arbejdsspænding. Status: rød RxCard LED tændt = PSU OK.Power supply unit in the cabinet. Converts 230V (from EPS SSR) to LED working voltage. Status: red RxCard LED on = PSU OK.
Søjle / Column 2 stablede kabinetter (bundkabinet + topkabinet). Signal og strøm løber ind i bundkabinettet. 61 søjler i alt = 122 kabinetter.2 stacked cabinets (bottom + top). Signal and power enter at the bottom cabinet. 61 columns total = 122 cabinets.
CVT10-S NovaStar fiberkonverter i loftet. Modtager 10G SFP+ fiber fra H15 og fordeler til 8 søjler via Cat6A (8 RJ45-porte). Strøm fra EPS SSR2. 8 enheder i alt.NovaStar fibre converter above the ceiling. Receives 10G SFP+ fibre from H15 and distributes to 8 columns via Cat6A (8 RJ45 ports). Power from EPS SSR2. 8 units total.
EPS Expromo EPS CPH Airport Special — strømstyringsenhed i loftet. SSR1: 16 kabinetter. SSR2: 16 kabinetter + CVT10-S. CPH tænder/slukker via TCP. RGB-LED viser status. Se §4.2.Expromo EPS CPH Airport Special — power management unit above the ceiling. SSR1: 16 cabinets. SSR2: 16 cabinets + CVT10-S. CPH powers on/off via TCP. RGB LED shows status. See §4.2.
FIDS Flight Information Display System — afgangs-/ankomstsystem leveret og drevet af CPH. 18 controllere (Check-in 21–38). Sender billedsignal til H15 via HDMI.Flight Information Display System — departure/arrival system supplied and operated by CPH. 18 players (Check-in 21–38). Sends image signal to H15 via HDMI.
H15 Controller NovaStar H15 Video Wall Splicer. Modtager HDMI fra FIDS, bearbejder og sender via 10G SFP+ fiber til CVT10-S. Front-LCD touch-display viser kortenes status. Control Card sidder øverst-højre på bagsiden.NovaStar H15 Video Wall Splicer. Receives HDMI from FIDS, processes and sends via 10G SFP+ fibre to CVT10-S. Front LCD touch display shows card status. Control Card sits top-right on the rear.
SFP+ SFP+-transceiver til 10G fiber (LC duplex single-mode). Monteret i H15 Output-kort og CVT10-S. Link-LED = forbindelsen er aktiv.10G fibre transceiver module (LC duplex single-mode). Mounted in H15 Output card and CVT10-S. Link LED = connection is active.
Cat6A Afskærmet Ethernet-kabel (RJ45). Bruges fra CVT10-S til bundkabinet (signal), og fra bundkabinet til topkabinet (link op).Shielded Ethernet cable (RJ45). Used from CVT10-S to bottom cabinet (signal), and from bottom cabinet to top cabinet (link up).
.ncp / rcfgx Konfigurationsfiler til RxCard — indeholder kalibrering og skærmkonfiguration. Overføres af L2 via NovaLCT. Kræves efter udskiftning af RxCard eller Motherboard.Configuration files for RxCard — contain calibration and screen configuration. Transferred by L2 via NovaLCT. Required after RxCard or Motherboard replacement.
